items.summary_en: Kilo Code for JetBrains is a fully native, open-source coding agent built specifically for JetBrains IDEs, rather than a web-based or external plugin tool. Because it runs inside the IDE, developers can get AI-agent assistance while staying in the editor they already use. It is aimed at JetBrains users who want the flexibility of an open-source coding agent in their existing toolchain.

items.summary_en: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1 as two safety tiers of the same model: Fable is generally available, while Mythos is restricted to vetted institutions. Fable 5.1 scores about twice as high as its predecessor on an agentic-science benchmark and can cut agent-call costs by up to 45%; risky requests may be blocked or routed to a weaker model. The approach decouples raw capability from who can use it in production.

items.summary_zh: Telegram 用户把验证码发给熟人的 bot，随后账号被对方反复踢下线；用 Google 指纹登录并补上 2FA 和邮箱后，仍因对方账号存在时间更长而无法踢回。现在考虑通过更换手机号强制对方离线，但不确定是否也受 24h 规则限制。这条博弈过程提醒：验证码不能交给 bot，应尽早注册 passkey 等恢复手段。
items.summary_en: A Telegram user lost their account after sending a verification code to an acquaintance's bot, then got repeatedly kicked offline. Even after signing back in via Google fingerprint and adding 2FA plus email recovery, they couldn't kick the other party out because that account had existed longer. They are now considering a phone-number change to force the attacker offline, though unsure about the 24-hour restriction. The incident is a reminder never to give verification codes to bots and to set up passkeys early.

The post explains why third-level domains are more fragile than second-level ones.

items.title: [Local LLM] 2 台 DGX Spark 上运行的本地 LLM 横向对比
items.summary_zh: 一位开发者在两台 DGX Spark 上对比了过去一周更新的三个 Flash 模型：Qwen3.8-Flash-Next、GLM-5.3-Flash 和 DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp。按其实测，GLM-5.3-Flash 在代码质量和图像理解上最强，Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 速度最快，DeepSeek V4 Flash 的图像细节识别偏弱；GLM 的 NVFP4 量化版 prefill 更快，EXL3 量化版 decode 更快，适合按本地推理负载需求选型参考。
items.summary_en: A developer compared three Flash-family models on two DGX Spark machines after the past week's updates: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, GLM-5.3-Flash, and DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp. Their hands-on results put GLM-5.3-Flash ahead on code quality and image understanding, Qwen3.8-Flash-Next ahead on raw speed, and DeepSeek's V4 Flash weakest on image details. The post also covers GLM's NVFP4 and EXL3 quantizations, which favor prefill speed and decode speed respectively. Useful for anyone planning local LLM deployment.

items.title: BMC 漏洞致数千台服务器面临硬件级入侵风险
items.summary_zh: Ars Technica 报道的研究警告，服务器 BMC（基板管理控制器）固件和 IPMI 协议漏洞可让攻击者在操作系统之下获得控制权，重装系统后仍能持续访问。BMC 独立于主 OS，传统端点工具看不见，且 IPMI 认证弱点自 2013 年公开后仍在生产环境出现。研究者建议把管理网络隔离、清除默认凭据并强化认证，GPU/AI 集群尤需如此。
items.summary_en: Research reported by Ars Technica warns that vulnerabilities in server BMCs—the out-of-band management processors on motherboards—can put attackers underneath the OS and give them persistence that survives a reinstall. Because BMC firmware and IPMI traffic are treated as infrastructure rather than security assets, endpoint defenses have little visibility; IPMI authentication weaknesses first documented in 2013 still show up in production. The authors urge isolating BMCs on dedicated management networks, removing default credentials, enforcing strong authentication, and making hardware management part of the security boundary, especially for GPU/AI clusters.

items.summary_zh: 这篇文章介绍 Pi——一个运行在 CLI 中的 Coding Agent，并分享将它与 DeepSeek-v4-Flash 组合使用的体验。作者 cxuan 称其用起来很顺手，适合喜欢在终端里完成编码任务的开发者。文章聚焦实践感受而非详细教程。
items.summary_en: This article introduces Pi, a coding agent that runs in the CLI, and shares hands-on experience pairing it with DeepSeek-v4-Flash. The author, cxuan, says the combination feels smooth and enjoyable, and adds that he has wanted to cover Pi for a long time. It targets developers who prefer terminal-based coding workflows and provides practical impressions rather than a full setup guide.
